title: Pick the home design and the mark for the SovereignWeb.site CRM
why: Two picks are Dinis's: the designs page says 'Dinis chooses the home design after seeing all five', and the brand page says 'three directions, Dinis picks one'. The answer unblocks crm.dev.a@AgentiCCells.dinis, who builds the chosen home at https://crm.tool.sovereignweb.site/app/ and copies the chosen mark, wordmarks, favicons and share card into the app's own assets. It also unblocks the rating: design.b.rounds holds the tool at 2 at most until the five designs are live (rule 2a). The five prototypes and the brand are by a.crm.design@SovereignWebsite.dinis on made-up data; nothing is pushed by this answer.
checks: design prototypes read live: design.agents.sovereignweb.site v0.1.118 (fa4a6cc), /designs/crm-tool/ and /designs/crm-tool/brand.html
live tool read: crm.tool.sovereignweb.site/app/ v0.1.31 (6f5908f), opens on Today
design.b.rounds round 1 (tool v0.1.3): rated 1 while one axe fault stood; every-morning 2 of 5; look 3.0; all five personas asked for The Day's first phone screen
design.b.rounds round 2 (tool v0.1.8): rated 2 of 5; axe clean on all eleven pages; every-morning 1 of 5; look 3.4; ranked first: Today must be the whole list
the designs page links no review round of the five prototypes themselves yet; neither review speaks to the mark
no private person, key or token in this request
options: home a) The Day: a desk diary, the first screen is today, each line with its one action. Well: answers 'What do I do this morning?'; the strongest on a phone (one column, the action full width); the live Today is its seed and round 2 says it lands. Badly: round 2 found the live Today shows one reason per card, so it offers a waiting draft on two companies where the board shows seven; it must become the whole list.

home b) The Board: a pipeline wall, one column per stage, each company a card turned over for its page. Well: seeing the whole pipeline and demos to a client; on a phone columns become tabs with counts. Badly: its first screen is stages, not the day's actions the personas asked for in both rounds.

home c) The Thread: built like an inbox, each company a conversation, Log an action is the reply box. Well: for people who live in email; fits the Email Cell. Badly: newest activity first, not what is due or overdue; on a phone it is list, then thread.

home d) The Map: who knows whom, companies grouped by where they came from, each person linked to whoever met them. Well: the summit follow-up and showing provenance. Badly: on a phone it has no wires, only the same facts in words, so its main idea is lost there; it is not a morning list.

home e) The Ledger: the dense, keyboard-first table, sortable, j and k to move, filters in the address, prints cleanly. Well: heavy daily use from a keyboard, and printing. Badly: on a phone rows must become cards; round 2 measured a table-first page (Follow-ups, 656 px on a 390 px screen) scrolling the whole page sideways.

mark a) The kept card (in use on every page now): a contact card with its corner turned down and a keyhole. Well: the only one that says both halves, contacts and your own vault, and it reads at 16 px as a card with a lock. Badly: the brand page names no weakness; no review has tested it with personas.
mark b) The follow-up: a loop arrow closing on a dot, the next step done on time. Well: suits The Day. Badly: says less about the vault.
mark c) The ring: a keyring with three tags, several vaults per person and the QR hand-over. Well: says vaults and hand-over. Badly: the weakest at 16 px.
recommendation: home a), mark a). Home: The Day, with The Ledger one click away for heavy use and The Board for demos, as a.crm.design recommends; both rounds point there (round 1: all five personas asked for The Day's first phone screen; round 2: Today lands and the founder said yes, 'Today is what I want at 8 in the morning'), and the every-morning score of 1 of 5 is about Today not yet being complete, which round 2's ranked list fixes, not about the design. Mark: The kept card; the reviews do not rate marks, so this rests on the brand page: the only one that says contacts and the vault, legible as a favicon, already in use on every page, while the ring is the weakest at 16 px.
answer_on: On the CRM site's 'For you' page (https://crm.tool.sovereignweb.site/app/), sealed to Dinis's browser key sha256:44de94420ec87df0 and answered there, signed with that key, as two letters (for example 'home a, mark a'). Not in chat.
